text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and avoid too much sugar and fast food. Second, exercise regularly — even a short walk every day makes a difference. Third, get enough sleep, because your body needs rest to stay strong. Don't forget mental health: talk to friends and family when you feel stressed. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance. Make time for hobbies and relaxation, not just work. Small daily habits like these can help you feel happier and healthier.
